title: The Revelation Timeline
sub: The Revelation of Jesus Christ · From Patmos to the New Jerusalem
desc: The Bible's final book, a vision given to John on Patmos moving through letters to seven churches, sealed judgments, trumpets and bowls of wrath, the fall of Babylon, Christ's return as a conquering king, and a new heaven and earth ending back at a tree of life.

eras.label: Era One · Revelation 1
eras.name: The Revelation of Jesus Christ — One Like a Son of Man
eras.dates: John on Patmos receives a vision of the glorified Christ, unlike anything in his earlier ministry

events.title: Blessed Is He Who Reads: the Alpha and the Omega
events.detail: John identifies the book as a revelation given to show what must soon happen, promising a blessing to whoever reads and keeps it, and opens with a doxology to the one who is, was, and is to come.

verses.text: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

events.title: One Like a Son of Man: I Am the First and the Last
events.detail: Exiled on Patmos, John turns to see a glorified Christ among seven golden lampstands, described in overwhelming imagery of fire, bronze, and a sharp sword, who identifies himself as the living one holding the keys of death and Hades.

verses.text: “I am the first and the last, and the living One; and I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever, and I have the keys of death and of Hades.”

eras.label: Era Two · Revelation 2
eras.name: Letters to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, and Thyatira
eras.dates: The first four of seven letters dictated to real churches in the Roman province of Asia, each with its own commendation and rebuke

events.title: Ephesus: You Have Left Your First Love
events.detail: Commended for perseverance and doctrinal discernment, Ephesus is rebuked for losing its original love, and urged to repent or lose its place as a lampstand.

verses.text: “I have this against you, that you have left your first love. Therefore remember from where you have fallen, and repent.”

events.title: Smyrna: Be Faithful Until Death
events.detail: The only church of the seven to receive no rebuke, Smyrna is warned of coming imprisonment and tribulation, promised a crown of life for enduring even to death.

verses.text: “Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.”

events.title: Pergamum: Where Satan's Throne Is
events.detail: Commended for holding fast Christ's name even where Satan dwells, Pergamum is rebuked for tolerating teaching that compromised with idolatry and sexual immorality.

verses.text: “I know where you dwell, where Satan's throne is; and you hold fast My name.”

events.title: Thyatira: Tolerating Jezebel
events.detail: Despite growing love and service, Thyatira is sharply rebuked for tolerating a prophetess likened to Jezebel who led believers into sexual immorality and idol worship, with a promise of authority to those who overcome.

verses.text: “I have this against you, that you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and she teaches and deceives My slaves.”

eras.label: Era Three · Revelation 3
eras.name: Letters to Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea
eras.dates: The final three letters, ranging from a church presumed dead to one merely lukewarm

events.title: Sardis: A Name That You Are Alive, But You Are Dead
events.detail: Sardis has a reputation for life but is spiritually dead, urged to wake up and strengthen what remains before Christ comes like a thief.

verses.text: “You have a name that you are alive, but you are dead. Wake up, and strengthen the things that remain.”

events.title: Philadelphia: An Open Door No One Can Shut
events.detail: Despite having little strength, Philadelphia receives no rebuke at all, promised an open door of opportunity and protection from the coming hour of testing.

verses.text: “I have given before you an open door which no one can shut, because you have a little power, and have kept My word.”

events.title: Laodicea: Neither Cold Nor Hot
events.detail: The most famous of the seven rebukes: a wealthy, self-satisfied church is spiritually lukewarm, blind, and naked, urged to buy true riches from Christ, who stands knocking at the door.

verses.text: “I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot… because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of My mouth.”
“Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and will dine with him.”

eras.label: Era Four · Revelation 4
eras.name: The Throne Room of Heaven
eras.dates: John is caught up into heaven itself, witnessing worship that has never stopped since creation

events.title: Holy, Holy, Holy: Worthy Are You, Our Lord and God
events.detail: John is summoned through an open door in heaven to see a throne surrounded by elders, living creatures, and unceasing worship, all directed at the Creator who is worthy of glory, honor, and power.

verses.text: “Worthy are You, our Lord and our God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things.”

eras.label: Era Five · Revelation 5
eras.name: The Lamb Who Was Slain Takes the Scroll
eras.dates: A sealed scroll no one is worthy to open until a slain-yet-standing Lamb steps forward

events.title: Worthy Is the Lamb That Was Slain
events.detail: John weeps because no one is found worthy to open a sealed scroll, until a Lamb bearing the marks of slaughter yet standing alive takes it, triggering worship from every creature in heaven, earth, and sea.

verses.text: “Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.”

eras.label: Era Six · Revelation 6
eras.name: The First Six Seals — the Four Horsemen and the Great Day of Wrath
eras.dates: The Lamb begins breaking the scroll's seals, unleashing conquest, war, famine, death, martyrdom, and cosmic upheaval

events.title: The Four Horsemen: Conquest, War, Famine, and Death
events.detail: The first four seals release four horsemen representing conquest, warfare, economic scarcity, and death, given authority over a fourth of the earth.

verses.text: “Behold, a pale horse; and he who sits on it had the name Death, and Hades was following with him. Authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth.”

events.title: How Long, O Master?: the Great Day of Wrath Has Come
events.detail: Martyred souls under the altar cry out for justice, and the sixth seal unleashes a cosmic earthquake so terrifying that even kings and the mighty beg the mountains to hide them from the Lamb's wrath.

verses.text: “Fall on us and hide us from the presence of Him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb… the great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

eras.label: Era Seven · Revelation 7
eras.name: The 144,000 Sealed — a Multitude No One Could Count
eras.dates: An interlude between the sixth and seventh seals protects God's people before the final judgment falls

events.title: 144,000 Sealed From Every Tribe of Israel
events.detail: Before the earth is harmed further, angels seal 144,000 servants of God, 12,000 from each of the twelve tribes, protecting them from what's still to come.

verses.text: “Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the slaves of our God on their foreheads.”

events.title: A Great Multitude No One Could Count: Every Tear Wiped Away
events.detail: A vision shifts to an uncountable multitude from every nation who have come out of the great tribulation, their robes washed white in the blood of the Lamb, promised an end to hunger, thirst, and tears.

verses.text: “The Lamb at the center of the throne will shepherd them and will guide them to springs of the water of life. And God will wipe every tear from their eyes.”

eras.label: Era Eight · Revelation 8
eras.name: The Seventh Seal — the First Four Trumpets
eras.dates: Silence in heaven gives way to a new cycle of judgment sounded by seven trumpets

events.title: Silence in Heaven: the Prayers of the Saints
events.detail: The seventh seal opens in dramatic silence, followed by an angel offering incense mixed with the prayers of the saints before the trumpet judgments begin.

verses.text: “When He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.”

events.title: The First Four Trumpets: a Third of the Earth Struck
events.detail: Four trumpets bring devastation to a third of the earth, sea, rivers, and sky, closing with an eagle crying woe over the three trumpet judgments still to come.

verses.text: “Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the remaining blasts of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound!”

eras.label: Era Nine · Revelation 9
eras.name: The Fifth and Sixth Trumpets — Locusts From the Abyss and a Vast Army
eras.dates: Two woes of demonic torment and warfare, killing a third of mankind yet failing to produce repentance

events.title: Locusts From the Abyss: Abaddon, the Destroyer
events.detail: The fifth trumpet releases monstrous locust-like creatures from the abyss, tormenting but not killing for five months, led by a king named Abaddon in Hebrew and Apollyon in Greek.

verses.text: “They have as king over them, the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek he has the name Apollyon.”

events.title: A Third of Mankind Killed: Yet They Did Not Repent
events.detail: The sixth trumpet releases four bound angels and a vast cavalry that kills a third of mankind, but the survivors still refuse to repent of idolatry, murder, sorcery, or sexual immorality.

verses.text: “The rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands… and they did not repent of their murders nor of their sorceries.”

eras.label: Era Ten · Revelation 10
eras.name: The Little Scroll — Sweet as Honey, Bitter in the Stomach
eras.dates: An interlude between the sixth and seventh trumpets, centered on a strange act of prophetic eating

events.title: The Little Scroll: Sweet as Honey, Bitter in the Stomach
events.detail: A mighty angel gives John a small scroll to eat, sweet in the mouth but bitter in the stomach, commissioning him to prophesy again about many peoples, nations, and kings.

verses.text: “I took the little scroll out of the angel's hand and ate it, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey; and when I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.”

eras.label: Era Eleven · Revelation 11
eras.name: The Two Witnesses — the Seventh Trumpet
eras.dates: Two prophetic witnesses are killed and resurrected before the seventh trumpet announces the kingdom's arrival

events.title: The Two Witnesses: Killed, Then Raised After Three and a Half Days
events.detail: Two witnesses prophesy in sackcloth for 1,260 days before being killed by the beast from the abyss, their bodies left in the street until the breath of life from God raises them and they ascend to heaven before their enemies' eyes.

verses.text: “The breath of life from God came into them, and they stood on their feet… they went up into heaven in the cloud.”

events.title: The Seventh Trumpet: the Kingdom of the World Has Become the Kingdom of Our Lord
events.detail: The seventh trumpet sounds a declaration that Christ's kingdom has arrived to stay, followed by the sanctuary of heaven opening to reveal the ark of the covenant amid thunder and earthquake.

verses.text: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.”

eras.label: Era Twelve · Revelation 12
eras.name: The Woman, the Child, and the Dragon
eras.dates: A cosmic sign reveals the true spiritual conflict behind the visions: a dragon at war with God's people

events.title: A Woman Clothed With the Sun: a Dragon Ready to Devour Her Child
events.detail: A woman in birth pains faces a great red dragon poised to devour her newborn son, who is instead caught up to God's throne while the woman flees into the wilderness for protection.

verses.text: “She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron; and her child was caught up to God and to His throne.”

events.title: War in Heaven: the Dragon Thrown Down
events.detail: Michael and his angels defeat the dragon in heavenly warfare, casting him down to the earth, where, enraged and out of time, he turns to make war on the rest of the woman's offspring and takes his stand on the seashore, waiting for the beast. (The Greek text's verse numbering places that final image, the dragon standing on the sand of the seashore, at the close of chapter 12 as verse 18; some English translations instead open chapter 13 with it, a versification difference only.)

verses.text: “The great dragon was thrown down, the serpent of old who is called the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world.”
“And the dragon stood on the sand of the seashore.”

eras.label: Era Thirteen · Revelation 13
eras.name: The Beast From the Sea and the Beast From the Earth
eras.dates: Two beasts, one political and one religious, enforce worship of the dragon through counterfeit resurrection and economic control

events.title: The Beast From the Sea: a Fatal Wound Healed
events.detail: A beast rises from the sea bearing the dragon's authority, given power to blaspheme and make war on the saints, worshiped by the whole earth after a seemingly fatal wound is healed.

verses.text: “I saw one of his heads as if it had been slain fatally, and his fatal wound was healed. And the whole earth marveled and followed after the beast.”

events.title: The Beast From the Earth: the Mark and the Number 666
events.detail: A second beast enforces worship of the first through deceptive signs, compelling everyone to receive a mark for buying and selling, closing with the famously cryptic number of the beast.

verses.text: “Here is wisdom. Let him who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of man; and his number is 666.”

eras.label: Era Fourteen · Revelation 14
eras.name: The Lamb on Zion — Three Angels and the Harvest of the Earth
eras.dates: The 144,000 reappear on Zion before angelic proclamations and a harvest imagery closes the chapter

events.title: The 144,000 on Mount Zion: Fallen Is Babylon
events.detail: The 144,000 stand with the Lamb on Zion singing a song no one else can learn, while three angels proclaim the eternal gospel, announce Babylon's fall, and warn against worshiping the beast.

verses.text: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all the nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

events.title: The Harvest of the Earth: the Great Winepress of God's Wrath
events.detail: One like a son of man reaps the earth with a sickle, and grapes of judgment are trodden in a great winepress of wrath, producing a river of blood.

verses.text: “The angel swung his sickle to the earth and gathered the clusters from the vine of the earth, and threw them into the great wine press of the wrath of God.”

eras.label: Era Fifteen · Revelation 15
eras.name: The Song of Moses and of the Lamb — the Seven Last Plagues
eras.dates: Victorious saints sing before the final and most severe series of judgments is prepared

events.title: The Song of Moses and of the Lamb
events.detail: Those who overcame the beast stand on a sea of glass singing a song celebrating God's righteous and true ways, just before seven angels receive the seven final bowls of wrath.

verses.text: “Great and marvelous are Your works, O Lord God, the Almighty; Righteous and true are Your ways, King of the nations!”

eras.label: Era Sixteen · Revelation 16
eras.name: The Seven Bowls of Wrath — Har-Magedon
eras.dates: The most concentrated series of judgments in the book, ending at the place remembered ever after as Armageddon

events.title: The Seven Bowls: It Is Done
events.detail: Seven bowls of God's wrath are poured out in rapid succession (sores, blood, scorching heat, darkness, and a gathering of kings at Har-Magedon) climaxing in a final earthquake and hailstorm as a voice declares, 'It is done.'

verses.text: “They gathered them together to the place which in Hebrew is called Har-Magedon… a loud voice came out of the sanctuary from the throne, saying, ‘It is done.’”

eras.label: Era Seventeen · Revelation 17
eras.name: The Great Harlot on the Scarlet Beast
eras.dates: A vision of Babylon personified as a harlot, explained in symbolic detail by an interpreting angel

events.title: Babylon the Great: the Mother of Harlots
events.detail: A great harlot sits on a scarlet beast, drunk with the blood of the saints, identified through symbolic kings and horns as a corrupting world power destined for destruction by the very beast that carries her.

verses.text: “On her forehead a name was written, a mystery, ‘BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.’”

eras.label: Era Eighteen · Revelation 18
eras.name: The Fall of Babylon the Great
eras.dates: An extended funeral dirge for a fallen economic and political power, mourned by kings, merchants, and sailors alike

events.title: Fallen, Fallen Is Babylon the Great
events.detail: Babylon's sudden destruction is mourned by the kings, merchants, and seafarers who profited from her wealth, while heaven is called to rejoice over the judgment finally rendered against her for the blood of the saints.

verses.text: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! And she has become a dwelling place of demons.”

eras.label: Era Nineteen · Revelation 19
eras.name: The Marriage Supper of the Lamb — the Rider on the White Horse
eras.dates: Heaven celebrates Babylon's fall before Christ returns as a conquering warrior-king

events.title: The Marriage Supper of the Lamb
events.detail: Heaven erupts in hallelujahs over Babylon's judgment, followed by the announcement of the Lamb's marriage, his bride clothed in the righteous acts of the saints.

verses.text: “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.”

events.title: Faithful and True: King of Kings and Lord of Lords
events.detail: Heaven opens to reveal a rider called Faithful and True, leading heaven's armies to defeat the beast and the false prophet, who are thrown alive into the lake of fire.

verses.text: “He has on His garment and on His thigh a name written, ‘KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.’”

eras.label: Era Twenty · Revelation 20
eras.name: The Thousand Years — the Great White Throne
eras.dates: Satan is bound, believers reign for a thousand years, and history closes at a final judgment before a great white throne

events.title: The Thousand Years: Satan Bound, Then Released and Destroyed
events.detail: Satan is bound for a thousand years while martyrs reign with Christ, then released briefly to deceive the nations one last time before being thrown permanently into the lake of fire.

verses.text: “The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are also.”

events.title: The Great White Throne: the Book of Life
events.detail: A final judgment before a great white throne opens the books, and anyone whose name is not found written in the book of life is thrown into the lake of fire, the second death.

verses.text: “If anyone's name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.”

eras.label: Era Twenty-One · Revelation 21
eras.name: A New Heaven and a New Earth — the New Jerusalem
eras.dates: The old order passes away entirely, replaced by a city of unimaginable dimensions and glory

events.title: Behold, I Am Making All Things New: No More Death or Mourning
events.detail: A new heaven and earth replace the old, and God himself comes to dwell among his people, wiping away every tear and ending death, mourning, and pain forever.

verses.text: “He will wipe away every tear from their eyes; and there will no longer be any death… Behold, I am making all things new.”

events.title: The New Jerusalem: Gates of Pearl, Streets of Gold
events.detail: An angel shows John the holy city descending from heaven in dazzling, precisely measured detail: gates of pearl, foundations of precious stone, streets of transparent gold, and no need for sun or temple since God's own glory illumines it.

verses.text: “The city has no need of the sun or of the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God has illumined it, and its lamp is the Lamb.”

eras.label: Era Twenty-Two · Revelation 22
eras.name: The River of Life — Come, Lord Jesus
eras.dates: The whole Bible's story closes back at a tree of life and a garden-like river, ending in an urgent invitation and a final prayer

events.title: The River of the Water of Life: the Tree of Life Restored
events.detail: A river of life flows from God's throne past a tree of life whose leaves heal the nations, closing the great inclusio with Eden that began the whole biblical story in Genesis, undoing the curse entirely.

verses.text: “On either side of the river was the tree of life… the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations. And there will no longer be any curse.”

events.title: Come, Lord Jesus: the Bible's Final Words
events.detail: The book, and the entire Christian Bible, closes with an urgent invitation to come and drink freely of the water of life, a warning against tampering with the prophecy's words, and the church's oldest recorded prayer for Christ's return.

verses.text: “He who bears witness to these things says, ‘Yes, I am coming quickly.’ Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.”
